IN-N-OUT SECRET MENU

Not on the board. Just ask for it by name.

Animal Style
A mustard-grilled patty, extra spread, grilled onions, and pickles on any burger. The most famous order on the secret menu.
Animal Style Fries
Fries topped with melted cheese, grilled onions, and spread.
Protein Style
Any burger wrapped in fresh lettuce instead of a bun. No carbs, no bun, all burger.
Flying Dutchman
Two beef patties and two slices of cheese — no bun, no veggies, no sauce. Just meat and cheese.
3x3 / 4x4
Three or four beef patties with three or four slices of cheese. Priced the same way as the regular menu, by patty and cheese count.
Grilled Cheese
Two slices of American cheese, lettuce, tomato, and spread — no meat.
Neapolitan Shake
A blend of all three milkshake flavors — chocolate, vanilla, and strawberry — in one cup.
Extra Toppings
Chopped chilies, whole grilled onion, and extra spread packets are all free for the asking.

No code word needed — just tell the cashier or the drive-thru speaker what you'd like.

    ISSUE 013

    WHAT’S HAPPENING
    IN LAS VEGAS...

    Fresh deals and things to do. New issue every Thursday at midnight.

    🌿 WEED — 10 DISPENSARIES TO CHECK

    1. Planet 13 — Las Vegas Open 24/7 with flower, vape, concentrate, edible, pre-roll, beverage, and locals offers. Current published examples include select 3.5g prepacks around $20, 2-for-$50 select prepacks, select 1g cured resin around $18, select live resin around $30, select live rosin around $45, and select 100mg beverages around $8. OPEN OFFICIAL LIVE MENU →
    2. Medizin — Sunset Road A strong stop for in-house flower, live resin, live rosin, carts, disposables, and infused pre-rolls. Published menu snapshots have included select 3.5g prepacks around $25, select .5g live resin around $13, select infused pre-roll bundles, and select carts or disposables in multi-buy offers. CHECK MEDIZIN SPECIALS →
    3. The Dispensary NV — Decatur / Eastern One of the broadest rotating deal boards in the valley. Current specials pages have shown examples such as 30%–40% off select brands, 35% off concentrates, $25/$35 flower tiers, rosin gummy discounts, and recurring vape or pod promotions. New-customer program: 30% off first visit, 35% off second visit, and 40% off third visit, subject to program rules. VIEW TODAY’S SPECIALS →
    4. Wallflower Cannabis House — Blue Diamond / Inspirada Especially worth checking for disposables, carts, pre-rolls, gummies, and Saturday ounce deals. Official recurring offers include everyday pre-rolls at 5 for $30 or 10 for $40, Just Edibles belts at 10 for $55, Mojo/Carbon .9g carts at 2 for $55 or 3 for $75, and select Saturday promotions including a $69 full ounce. OPEN WALLFLOWER DEALS →
    5. Reef / Curaleaf — Western Avenue Large live menu with dozens of featured deals across flower, vapes, pre-rolls, concentrates, and edibles. The official menu advertises featured-deal inventory and a $5 first-order offer after signup. Use the live menu because prices and brands rotate frequently. SEE REEF FEATURED DEALS →
    6. Green Cannabis Co. — Rainbow / Hualapai / North / Henderson Locally focused stores with daily specials, first-order savings, and a rewards program. Official offers include 20% off a first order with code WELCOME20 and double rewards points every Tuesday. Each location has a separate live specials page covering flower, vapes, edibles, pre-rolls, and concentrates. SELECT A GREEN LOCATION →
    7. The Source — Las Vegas / Henderson / North Las Vegas A live specials system organized by location and category. Check the official specials portal for current vaporizers, disposable vapes, carts, pods, edibles, extracts, flower, pre-rolls, and topicals. Exact deal pricing changes by store. OPEN THE SOURCE SPECIALS →
    8. Oasis Cannabis — Industrial Road Local dispensary with flower, vapes, edibles, concentrates, delivery, and rotating menu specials. Delivery is free on $75+ subtotals, $10 on $50–$74.99 orders, and free for veterans with valid military ID. Use the live specials filter for current product discounts. SHOP OASIS LIVE MENU →
    9. Cultivate — Spring Mountain / Durango Known for date-stamped daily deal posts and mix-and-match flower pricing. Recent official deal posts have included mix-and-match half-ounce pricing, percentage discounts on select brands, and rotating concentrate, vape, edible, and flower specials. Confirm the date at the top before using any posted deal. CHECK CULTIVATE DAILY DEALS →
    10. Thrive Cannabis Marketplace Multiple valley locations with flower, concentrates, tinctures, edibles, pre-rolls, vapes, and store-specific menus. Thrive’s inventory and promotions vary by location, so choose the store first and check the same-day menu before driving. CHOOSE A THRIVE LOCATION →
    Specials are submitted by businesses or their staff and may change without notice. Screenshot the offer, then confirm the details and inventory directly with the business before leaving.

    VAPE BOARD — CARTS, PODS & DISPOSABLES

    Wallflower Mojo & Carbon .9g carts: 2 for $55 or 3 for $75 on the recurring official deal board. Other day-specific listings rotate Airo, Cake, Stiiizy, Rythm, Matrix, IndoPuff, and 1g–2g disposables.
    The Dispensary NV Live specials pages regularly show pod, cart, disposable, and brand-percentage offers. Recent official listings have included 30% off STIIIZY and 30%–40% off select vape brands.
    Green Cannabis Co. Every Green location has a live Vapes category and store-specific specials page. First orders can receive 20% off with WELCOME20, subject to eligibility.
    Reef / Curaleaf The Las Vegas Strip menu includes a dedicated Vape category and dozens of featured deals. Sign in to see location-specific pricing and inventory.
    The Source The official specials page has separate categories for vape cartridges, pods, and disposable vapes, making it one of the easiest places to compare vape-focused promotions.

    💨 TOBACCO & SMOKE SHOPS — WEEKLY WATCH

    What we’re tracking Disposable nicotine vapes, refillable devices, pods, e-liquid, cigars, hookah tobacco, papers, glass, torches, nicotine pouches, and late-night shop hours.
    Why this section changes differently Many local smoke shops publish specials through social media or in-store signs instead of a stable official deals page. WTF will not invent a price just to fill space.
    Smoke-shop deal submission Local shops can send a photo of the current in-store promotion, exact address, expiration, restrictions, and contact number. Verified offers can be added to the next Thursday-at-midnight issue.
    Customer price reports Readers can report a verified disposable, cigar, hookah, glass, pouch, or accessory price. We will contact the store before publishing it as a featured deal.
    Nicotine and tobacco products are for adults 21+. Availability, legality, flavors, and product rules can change. Bring valid ID and confirm the exact item before driving.

    🍔 FOOD — CHEAP EATS, GRAVEYARD & LATE NIGHT

    South Point — Coronado Café Six graveyard entrees from $2.95 to $6.95, served seven days a week. The 24-hour café also advertises prime rib and porterhouse steak entrees at $22.95. Confirm the graveyard serving window and players-card requirements when seated. SEE CORONADO CAFÉ →
    Ellis Island — Village Pub & Café $9.99 filet-cut top sirloin steak special. The off-menu special requires the “Play $5, Get $2” kiosk coupon with a Passport Players Club card. The Village Pub & Café is open 24/7. VIEW THE OFFICIAL STEAK DEAL →
    South Point — Big Sur Oyster Bar “What the Shuck” happy hour daily from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. Officially advertised offers include half-priced raw oysters and clams plus specially priced food selections such as fish tacos, salmon pasta, shrimp curry, ahi salad, and a crab cake BLT. SEE BIG SUR DETAILS →
    South Point — Garden Buffet Six live cooking stations with weekday breakfast, lunch, and dinner plus weekend brunch and dinner. Pricing and themed menus change, so use the official buffet page for the day’s current service and price before heading over. CHECK TODAY’S BUFFET →
    Ellis Island — 24/7 Late-Night Value Ellis Island promotes 24/7 dining and the famous steak special as its signature value. The dinner menu also lists lower-priced breakfast and diner staples compared with many Strip restaurants. BROWSE ELLIS ISLAND DINING →
    Casino specials may require a players card, kiosk coupon, gaming activity, dine-in service, or a specific time window. Ask before ordering.
